title: Jolly LLB 3 Advance Bookings: Akshay Kumar And Arshad Warsi's Film Earns Rs 1.68 Crore | Bollywood News - News18
text: Jolly LLB 3, starring Akshay Kumar and Arshad Warsi, is set to hit theatres in a few days. The courtroom comedy-drama, directed by Subhash Kapoor, is already performing well in pre-bookings. The film reunites the two Jollys from the blockbuster franchise and is expected to do well in the Hindi market, thanks to its legacy and star power. Advance bookings for Jolly LLB 3 opened ahead of its September 19 release. According to early reports from Sacnilk, the film has earned approximately Rs 1.68 crore, with around 64,613 tickets sold in presales. The movie relies heavily on word-of-mouth, making its weekend performance crucial. If the creators deliver high-quality content, box office collections are expected to surge. However, the film’s release on a working Friday, rather than a festival, may slightly limit its initial advantage. Jolly LLB 3 Certification Details The Jolly LLB franchise has always delivered drama, laughter, and courtroom chaos, and the third installment is no different. This time, audiences will witness Akshay Kumar’s Jolly face off against Arshad Warsi’s Jolly in what many are calling the franchise’s biggest showdown yet. According to Bollywood Hungama, Jolly LLB 3 has a runtime of 2 hours, 37 minutes, and 16 seconds (157.16 minutes). The CBFC granted the film a U/A 16+ certificate after recommending minor changes that did not affect the plot. Jolly LLB 3: Plot And Cast Jolly LLB 3 is directed by Subhash Kapoor, who also helmed the first two installments. The film features Saurabh Shukla, Huma Qureshi, Amrita Rao, Seema Biswas, and Gajraj Rao in key roles. With the franchise’s popularity and the much-anticipated courtroom showdown between Akshay Kumar and Arshad Warsi, box office expectations are high. The film tackles socially relevant issues, focusing on farmers’ land rights when a politician attempts to seize their property. This sparks a legal battle, with the two Jollys competing to outwit each other in court while highlighting the challenges faced by ordinary citizens.
